prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Pearland, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1210; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on the recording, so I'll just say I'm the driver of the vehicle that was struck.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the accident occurred?

A: It was on a main road in Pearland, Texas, near a shopping center. I was stopped in traffic at a red light.

Q: What happened while you were stopped?

A: The car behind me didn't stop in time. I felt a hard jolt from behind and my head snapped forward and then back.

Q: Did you exchange information with the other driver?

A: Yes, we exchanged insurance details. The other driver said they looked down at their phone for a second.

Q: Were there any police or EMS at the scene?

A: An officer came and filed a report. I was checked by paramedics but I declined transport at the time.

Q: How are you feeling now?

A: My neck is stiff and sore, especially when I turn my head to check traffic. My lower back aches when I sit for a long time.

Q: Have you seen a doctor since the accident?

A: Yes, I went to my primary care physician two days later. They diagnosed a neck and back strain and gave me muscle relaxers and referred me to physical therapy.

Q: Have you had any prior neck or back problems?

A: No, nothing serious. I had some occasional stiffness from sitting at a desk, but nothing that stopped me from working.

Q: Are you still working?

A: I've been working but I've had to take some shifts off because of the pain, and I'm limiting how long I can drive.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I want to make sure my medical treatment is covered while I recover. Thank you.
